explicit_ACs: Users can register using a manual registration form with the following fields: — Name: Required. Error if empty: "Name is required".
Users can register using a manual registration form with the following fields: — Email: Required. Must be a valid email format. Error if invalid: "Invalid email number".
Users can register using a manual registration form with the following fields: — Password: Required. Masked input. Error if empty: "Password is required".
Users can register using a manual registration form with the following fields: — Confirm Password: Required. Masked input. Error if empty: "Confirm the password".
Users can register using a manual registration form with the following fields: — Create Account Button: Validates all fields and creates the account. On success, redirects to the Home Screen.
Users can register quickly using their existing Google identity: — Sign up with Google Button: Initiates the Google OAuth 2.0 flow when tapped.
There is a path for users who already have an account to prevent duplicate registrations: — Log in Link: Text "Log in" located at the bottom of the form.
If the email is already registered, display the message: "An account with this email already exists".
implicit_ACs: The sign up screen displays the Exclusive platform logo or brand name prominently, above the registration form.
The sign up screen displays a prominent heading such as 'Create Account' or 'Sign Up' at the top of the registration form.
The sign up screen displays a short subtitle or instructional line beneath the heading, such as 'Enter your details below'.
A visual divider (e.g. a horizontal line with the label 'or') separates the manual registration form from the 'Sign up with Google' button.
The 'Sign up with Google' button displays the recognisable Google logo icon alongside its label text.
The log in link is preceded by static prompt text such as 'Already have an account?' displayed inline at the bottom of the form.
